a: OGA is the OGITECH Student Awards — an annual, student-run celebration of excellence on campus.
Eligible OGITECH students who register as nominees and are approved by the organising team.

q: How do I register as a nominee?
a: When nominations are open, use the Register as Nominee button, create your account and pick a category.
Our team reviews entries during the nomination window. You can follow your status from your nominee dashboard.
Pick a nominee, choose how many votes you want, and pay securely. Votes are counted once the payment is verified.

q: Is there a limit on votes?
a: Yes. There is a maximum number of votes per payment, shown on the voting page.

q: How do I get my ticket after buying?
a: Your ticket appears right after payment. You can always retrieve it on the Tickets page with your reference and email.
Each ticket has a unique QR code that can be scanned once at the gate. Contact us if you need help with a transfer.
